name: Car Sharing
description: Car sharing station locations and vehicle availability

summary.available: {count, plural, =0 {No cars available} one {1 car available} other {# cars available}}
summary.slots: {count, plural, =0 {No empty slots} one {1 empty slot} other {# empty slots}}

de-cambio.purpose: Station-based car sharing in Germany and Belgium
de-cambio.dataSent: Region code in URL path (matched by proximity to viewport center, up to 14 regions). No user location data sent directly
de-cambio.dataReceived: Station locations, vehicle counts, vehicle classes, addresses

de-stadtteilauto.purpose: Car sharing stations and vehicles in Münster (open data)
de-stadtteilauto.dataSent: No user data (static dataset, fetches all stations)
de-stadtteilauto.dataReceived: Station locations, vehicle counts, vehicle classes, pricing

de-nw-bielefeld.purpose: Car sharing stations in Bielefeld (open data)
de-nw-bielefeld.dataSent: No user data (static dataset, fetched in parallel with stations)

de-nw-wuppertal.purpose: Car sharing stations in Wuppertal from multiple operators (open data)
de-nw-wuppertal.dataSent: No user data (static WFS query with fixed parameters for carsharing layer)
de-nw-wuppertal.dataReceived: Station locations, vehicle counts, provider names, vehicle classes

gbfs.dataSent: No user data (static dataset, fetches all stations)
gbfs.dataReceived: GBFS feed URLs for car-sharing operators

entur-mobility.purpose: Enrich Norwegian car-sharing stations and vehicles with operator branding, pricing plans, rental apps and geofencing zones via the Entur Mobility API
entur-mobility.dataSent: GBFS station and vehicle identifiers (and system identifiers for geofencing) of items already found within the viewport. No user account or raw location data
entur-mobility.dataReceived: Operator branding, pricing plans, vehicle type details, rental apps/URIs, station addresses, geofencing zones
